IT Helpdesk FAQ

How do I reset my password? Go to the self-service portal at reset.kaveri.example and verify with your registered mobile number. The helpdesk cannot see or tell you your password.

The VPN does not connect from home. Check that your laptop date and time are correct, then restart the VPN client. If it still fails, raise a ticket with the error code shown.

How do I get access to the ERP? Your manager raises an access request in the ERP access form. Access is granted within 1 working day after approval.

What are the helpdesk hours? The helpdesk is open from 8 AM to 8 PM, Monday to Saturday. For urgent production outages outside these hours, call the on-call number printed on your ID card.

Can I install my own software? No. Request software through the software catalogue; IT installs only licensed and approved software.
